text: **Joint constraints, 200 draws** (`sample.py joint 200`, no simulation): 85 of 200 break a constraint the default worm reads, every one guessed against guessed: met_E_mV 65, glia_e_leak_mV 17, sens_glia_e_leak_mV 10, endo_e_leak_mV 3, other_e_leak_mV 1 (outside [E_K, E_Na]); 42 more break only constraints on rows of other forms (c302 muscle, mact). The sampler redraws (seed + 1000 k) until a worm obeys them. **20 worms x 2 s** (`sample.py run 20 2`, Mac via slot.py, 7 Nov 12:58-13:12 CST, about 41 s wall each): 13 draws rejected on the way to 20; code-default forms (everything on), no injected current, no body. Checks at every 1 ms read: voltages and Ca finite; voltages inside the hard reversal envelope [-143, 196] mV; Ca >= 0; activations in [0, 1]; concentration, store and count outputs >= 0. **17 of 20 pass.** (Seed 1 was first scored failing on gcamp_dff below 0, a false positive of the check: dF/F falls below rest; the check was corrected during the run.) Seeds 2, 4, 13 fall to -384, -207, -208 mV. The source is the glia K+ buffer (`glia_kbuffer = kir`, src/wormemu/mech/glia.py; `sample.py diag 2 2`: ADLR at -384 mV takes -146 pA from it). It drives each amphid neuron with a fixed current g_K x dE_K, not a conductance, so a hyperpolarisation lowers ending K+ and deepens itself; ending K+ may fall to 0.001 x bath, below the hard K+ window (1-30 mM). It runs away where glia_k_gleak_nS / (glia_k_volume_um3 x clearance rate) is large: 0.19-0.24 in the three, at most 0.06 in the other 17. With `glia_kbuffer = fixed` the same three draws stay inside (v_min -77, -89, -78 mV). A code form, listed for wmodel (docs/worm/night/2026-11-07_wranges.md); no range was changed for it.
